Subject: 30 March NG Cut Over

Shane,

On Saturday, 30 March, Kestrel Energy will cut over natural gas supply from Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to Coral at Millbrook plant.

In order to accomplish cut over activities, we will need a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge at Millbrook plant to participate in the activities and to insure Tasman Ridge's interests and assets are protected.

Would you please make arrangements to have a Tasman Ridge technical representative(s) report at 12:00 noon, 30 March, to the Main Guard House at Millbrook plant and ask for Kestrel Energy's Ronald Martin. Jorge is coordinating all the cut over operations.

If you have any questions about this, please contact me (at the numbers indicated below) or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
